verified.note: White plate with black fork and knife on a black tile, as described.

verified.note: Glossy silver-white to pale grey-blue round button with a grey-blue rim holding a bold black X, as described.

cards.name: Delete - Orange
cards.summary: Symbol 'Delete - Orange' from Illustrator's Mobile symbol library: a glossy round button, golden yellow brightening to pale yellow near the bottom, with a darker amber rim, holding a bold black X. The name says Orange, but the picture is gold-yellow and amber rather than a true orange; the picture wins. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 64 x 64 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a labelled button: the icon has no text; add the label beside it with the Type tool
a calm neutral look: the gold-yellow button is loud; use the Grey version for secondary buttons
a flat or modern look: the glossy bevel is baked in; break the link and set flat fills for a flat UI
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
